articles.title: Nvidia and auto suppliers roll out partnerships to rekindle self-driving push
articles.mainIdea: Nvidia and auto suppliers roll out partnerships to rekindle self-driving push
articles.summary: Reuters: Nvidia and auto suppliers roll out partnerships to rekindle self-driving push. The short history of the self-driving car industry has been littered with expensive failures and endless delays, but tech suppliers, chipmakers including Nvidia and some automakers are betting on AI and a web of partnerships to spark new progress. Many interested automakers, however, still have major questions. Vehicles that drive themselves would change the ‌transportation landscape, but making such a technology safe for public roads has been harder and much more expensive than expected. Related tickers mentioned: GM, GOOG, NVDA, TSLA.

articles.title: How The Narrative Around Uber Technologies (UBER) Is Shifting With AV And AI Repricing
articles.mainIdea: How The Narrative Around Uber Technologies (UBER) Is Shifting With AV And AI Repricing
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: How The Narrative Around Uber Technologies (UBER) Is Shifting With AV And AI Repricing. Uber Technologies has just seen its fair value estimate nudged slightly lower, from about US$112.06 to about US$110.72 per share, reflecting a very modest recalibration rather than a wholesale rethink. The updated model threads a slightly higher discount rate of about 8.05% together with a very small adjustment to the long term revenue growth assumption, now about 14.60%, as analysts weigh both enthusiasm and caution around autonomous vehicles and AI.
